definitions.explanation: A thin sushi roll filled with cucumber, wrapped in nori and rice. One of the simplest and most familiar sushi roll varieties.

examples.japanese: かっぱ{巻|ま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
かっぱ{巻|ま}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦さっぱりして→さっぱりする：26802_sapparisuru⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{食|た}べやすい→食べやすい：21799_tabeyasui⟧。
examples.english: Cucumber rolls are refreshing and easy to eat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{回転寿司|かいてんずし}→回転寿司：11900_kaitenzushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧かっぱ{巻|ま}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。
examples.english: So that children can eat them too, cucumber rolls are a standard item at conveyor-belt sushi restaurants.

notes:
Named after ⟦{河童|かっぱ}→河童：06521_kappa⟧, the legendary water creature said to love cucumbers. かっぱ{巻|ま}き is one of the most basic and inexpensive items on a sushi menu.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- かっぱ{巻|ま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧: to order a cucumber roll
- かっぱ{巻|ま}き⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧{本|ぽん}: one cucumber roll

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鉄火巻|てっかま}き: tuna roll — similarly thin roll, filled with raw tuna instead of cucumber
- ⟦{細巻|ほそま}き→細巻き：21366_hosomaki⟧: thin sushi roll — the general category that かっぱ{巻|ま}き and {鉄火巻|てっかま}き belong to
